global_protocol.denominator_policy: Every rate reports numerator, denominator unit, exclusions, missingness and coverage. Zero matching exposures is no_evaluable_exposure, never 0% violation.
global_protocol.tolerance_policy: Hard safety invariants are zero-tolerance per sample; numerical comparisons use each test absolute/relative tolerances and may not average away violations.
global_protocol.seed_policy: The pure Langchao kernel has no random source. Seeds are mandatory only for Runtime-v2 hazard, generators, sampling or multi-seed comparisons and must be recorded before execution.
global_protocol.timeout_policy: Timeout is not a pass or defer: fail closed, preserve partial evidence, and report the exact unfinished stage.
